name: Shanxi Coal International Energy Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Shanxi Coal International Energy Group Co.,Ltd engages in the coal production business in China. It offers raw coal and power coal; and trades in thermal, cooking, anthracite, and semi-anthracite coal products. The company also engages in production, washing, sales, trade, and transportation services; and sourcing and warehousing services, as well as coal mining; general waterway cargo transportation; ship inspection services; domestic ship management; and import and export business. It serves steelmaking enterprises and power plants industries. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Taiyuan, China.
